metaDescription: Shopify store for Habitt, a Pakistani home store: furniture by room, decor, bedding, kitchen and serving, with wish lists and installment payments.
summary: Shopify store for a home retailer selling furniture, decor, bedding and kitchenware.
overview: Habitt describes itself as a one stop shop for the home, selling furniture for every room alongside decor, bedding, kitchenware, serving, bath and storage. We built Habitt's Shopify store to hold that large catalog, from a single mug to a full bedroom set.
challenge: The range spans low-cost kitchen items and furniture sets that cost many times more, across dozens of categories. Shoppers furnishing a room need to browse by room, while shoppers buying a dinner set need to compare sizes and prices quickly.
approach: A dark header with a wide search bar sits over a menu for Sale, Furniture, Decor, Bedding and comfort, Kitchen, Serving, Bath, Storage and organizers and Appliances. Furniture is broken down by room: bedroom, living room, dining room, kids, study, outdoor and office, with furniture and wedding bundles. Collection pages add a sub-category image carousel, a category sidebar, grid view options, items per page and sorting. Product pages show SKU, stock status, product type, size options such as dinner sets for 4, 6 or 8 people, a Baadmay pay-in-3 box, a wish list button and both Add to cart and Buy it now.
outcome: A Shopify store where shoppers can furnish a room or pick up a kitchen tool from the same menu, save items to a wish list and spread larger purchases over installments.

process.title: Menu by room
process.body: Furniture is split into bedroom, living room, dining room, kids, study, outdoor and office, while home categories cover decor, bedding, cookware, bakeware and kitchen storage.

process.title: Collections
process.body: Collection pages open with an image carousel of sub-categories, then a category sidebar, grid view toggles, items per page and sorting, with sale percentages on product cards.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Each product lists SKU, availability and product type, the sale and original price, size options, a Baadmay installment box and a wish list button next to the cart buttons.

process.title: Mobile and support
process.body: The mobile home page leads with campaign banners and a deal of the month row, and product pages offer an ask an expert button for questions over WhatsApp.

whyItMatters: Home shoppers usually think in rooms, not product types, and big pieces are considered purchases. Room-based menus, wish lists and installment options match how people actually furnish a home.

faqs.q: What platform is the Habitt store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Ella theme, using Shopify collections for room-based furniture, home categories, bundles and sale sections.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for furniture and home brands, including room-based navigation, large catalogs and installment payment options. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
